bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to the operation and financing of state and local government; repealing Laws 2024, chapter 127; directing various entities to submit conforming legislation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. REPEALER; CONFORMING LEGISLATION.

Subdivision 1.

Repealer.

Laws 2024, chapter 127, is repealed retroactively from May 23, 2024.

Subd. 2.

Conforming legislation.

By January 15, 2026, each executive branch agency and board and each constitutional office must submit to the legislature draft legislation that achieves the repeal of Laws 2024, chapter 127, by July 1, 2026, in accordance with subdivision 1.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

(a) Subdivision 1 is effective July 1, 2026.

(b) Subdivision 2 is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: Laws 2024, chapter 127, is repealed retroactively from May 23, 2024.
